lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba4Mg14Zn2 (reduced formula Ba2Mg7Zn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis using CrystalNN identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ba and Zn each have 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg environments range from 12 to 13 neighbors (Mg, Ba, and Zn), with neighbor distances near 3.08–3.46 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing contacts among 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
